title: Rabdan Avenue
summary: A three-video launch campaign created in 2026 for Rabdan Developments, consisting of a Launch Video, Render Video, and Lifestyle Video.
description:
A three-video launch campaign created in 2026 for Rabdan Developments, consisting of a Launch Video, Render Video, and Lifestyle Video.

I developed the project end-to-end using AI, covering concept development, creative direction, AI production, post-production, editing, and final delivery. The three videos were designed as one cohesive visual campaign to introduce and position the new development.
